name: Swarm-style repo scan (sequential steps in one Iso)
description: TODO/FIXME grep, largest scripts, then reminder to run kmac tron check on the host

steps.name: todo-fixme-hits
steps.run: echo '=== TODO / FIXME / XXX (first 25, repo sources only) ===' && (grep -REIn '\b(TODO|FIXME|XXX)\b' --include='*.sh' --include='*.py' --include='*.md' --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=.venv --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=venv . 2>/dev/null | head -25) || true

steps.name: largest-scripts
steps.run: echo '=== Line counts (scripts/, top 10) ===' && wc -l scripts/* 2>/dev/null | sort -n | tail -10 || true

steps.name: next-step
steps.run: echo '' && echo 'Next on host: kmac tron check   # full CI-parity gate in Docker'
